title: Identity and access correlation pack
notes: Covers repeated authentication failures, first-seen app access and access-grant drift on SSO-enabled systems.
Suppression key: host.name + service.name + rule family.

stream_rules.title: Repeated External App Authentication Failures
stream_rules.operator_action: Review the principal, source address and target application before forcing password rotation or access suspension.
stream_rules.sigma_yaml:
title: Repeated External App Authentication Failures
id: sigma-repeated-external-app-auth-failures
status: experimental
logsource:
  product: application
  service: sso
detection:
  selection_outcome:
    event.outcome: failure
  selection_app:
    log_source:
      - pilot-web-01
      - navidrome-01
      - nextcloud-siem
  condition: selection_outcome and selection_app
level: medium

stream_rules.title: First-Seen Login On SSO-Enabled Internal App
stream_rules.operator_action: Confirm the new principal-to-app combination is expected and that the access grant was intentional.
stream_rules.sigma_yaml:
title: First-Seen Login On SSO-Enabled Internal App
id: sigma-first-seen-login-on-sso-app
status: experimental
logsource:
  product: application
  service: sso
detection:
  selection_outcome:
    event.outcome: success
  selection_type:
    event.type:
      - auth_login_success
      - oidc_login_success
  condition: selection_outcome and selection_type
level: low

stream_rules.title: SSO Role Or Grant Drift Detected
stream_rules.operator_action: Inspect the grant change, Keycloak group delta and the operator who applied it before allowing the drift to stand.
stream_rules.sigma_yaml:
title: SSO Role Or Grant Drift Detected
id: sigma-sso-role-or-grant-drift-detected
status: experimental
logsource:
  product: siem
  service: access
detection:
  selection_action:
    event.action:
      - keycloak.user.groups_updated
      - keycloak.user.roles_updated
      - access_grant_saved
  condition: selection_action
level: high
